payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of how crowd workers were instructed to identify important elements in document collections through a new crowdsourcing scheme called low-context importance annotation.

claims.text: Crowd workers were instructed to use a low-context importance annotation scheme to identify important elements in document collections without reading all documents.
The low-context importance annotation scheme allows workers to determine summary-worthy parts of documents efficiently and intuitively, overcoming previous challenges in crowdsourcing.
